en: Vertex AI trained on thousands of historical and current FA scouting reports.
Generates concise player development summaries to help discover future talent.
Complements objective data with subjective scout assessments.
Part of an ongoing Google Cloud partnership that began in 2019 with BigQuery.

Editorial Assistant Agent processes long manuscripts and provides data-backed market analysis.
Reduces manual review time for editorial staff at publishing houses.

編輯助理代理處理長篇手稿並提供有數據支撐的市場分析。
減少出版社編輯人員的手動審查時間。

Enterprise-grade governance, security, and data privacy built into every AI capability.

2-million-token context window makes some tasks up to 10x faster to process.
Entire documents can be processed within a single context, improving accuracy.

200 萬 token 上下文視窗使某些任務處理速度提升最多 10 倍。

為媒體營運商提供集中控制和對傳輸流程的完整可視性。

summary.zh: Capcom 使用 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 每月執行超過 30,000 小時的自動化遊戲測試，讓開發者專注於創意工作。

overview.en: Capcom is using the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to build playtesting and predictive agents that improve the gameplay experience while freeing developers for creative work. The system conducts 30,000+ hours of autonomous playtesting per month using visual inspection agents (Gemini Vision) and predictive agents that identify high-risk areas for testing. This allows Capcom's creative teams to shift from "defensive development" to high-value creative innovation.
overview.zh: Capcom 使用 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 構建遊戲測試和預測代理，在改善遊戲體驗的同時讓開發者專注於創意工作。系統每月使用視覺檢查代理（Gemini Vision）和識別高風險測試區域的預測代理執行超過 30,000 小時的自主遊戲測試。這讓 Capcom 的創意團隊能從「防禦性開發」轉向高價值創意創新。

en: 30,000+ hours of autonomous playtesting conducted per month.
Visual inspection agents use Gemini Vision to distinguish design choices from technical failures.
Predictive agents analyze historical data to direct test bots to high-risk areas.
Developers freed from repetitive testing to focus on creative innovation.
Leverages Gemini Enterprise, BigQuery, and Google's Agent Development Kit.

summary.en: WPP used Google Cloud G4 VMs with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell to accelerate humanoid robot training by 10x for filming tasks.
summary.zh: WPP 使用 Google Cloud 搭載 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 的 G4 VM，將人形機器人訓練速度提升 10 倍，用於拍攝任務。

overview.en: WPP used the new G4 VM instance powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell on Google Cloud to accelerate humanoid robot training for filming tasks in challenging or dangerous environments. Using Google Cloud's AI Hypercomputer, training times were reduced by more than 10x—from 24 hours down to less than one hour. The workflow included human motion capture, retargeting to an OpenUSD digital twin using MuJoCo, and reinforcement learning training using NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
overview.zh: WPP 使用 Google Cloud 上搭載 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 的新 G4 VM 實例，加速人形機器人在挑戰性或危險環境中執行拍攝任務的訓練。使用 Google Cloud 的 AI Hypercomputer，訓練時間縮短超過 10 倍，從 24 小時降至不到 1 小時。工作流程包括人體動作捕捉、使用 MuJoCo 重新定向至 OpenUSD 數位孿生，以及使用 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 進行強化學習訓練。

en: Humanoid robot training accelerated by 10x using G4 VMs on Google Cloud.
Training time reduced from 24 hours to less than 1 hour.
Trained a Unitree G1 robot to perform a dance sequence from a Universal Music Group project.
Workflow uses OptiTrack motion capture, MuJoCo, and NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
Enables filming in challenging or dangerous environments using robots.
